title: verbena cajamarcensis
intro: Verbena cajamarcensis, commonly known as the Andean verbena, is a plant species native to the Andean region of South America. It has been used traditionally for its medicinal properties and is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce stress. The therapeutic actions of Verbena cajamarcensis include its sedative and anti-anxiety properties, which can promote relaxation and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic actions.
